---
title: ""
page-layout: full
include-in-header:
  text: |
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@400;600;700;800&family=Manrope:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
    <link href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.0/css/all.min.css" rel="stylesheet"/>
    <style>
      /* HERO */
      .hero-wrap { padding: 5rem 2rem 4rem; max-width:900px; margin:0 auto; }
      .hero-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; background:#EEF2FF; color:#6366F1; font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; padding:6px 14px; border-radius:999px; margin-bottom:1.5rem; }
      .hero-badge span { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:#6366F1; display:inline-block; animation:pulse 2s infinite; }
      @keyframes pulse { 0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)} 50%{opacity:.5;transform:scale(.8)} }
      .hero-cols { display:flex; gap:3rem; align-items:center; }
      .hero-text { flex:1; }
      .hero-text h1 { font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-size:3rem; font-weight:800; line-height:1.1; letter-spacing:-0.03em; margin-bottom:1.2rem; }
      .hero-text p { font-size:1rem; color:#64748B; font-weight:400; max-width:480px; margin-bottom:1.8rem; line-height:1.8; }
      .hero-btns { display:flex; gap:0.8rem; flex-wrap:wrap; }
      .hero-avatar-col { flex-shrink:0; }
      .avatar-ring { width:180px; height:180px; border-radius:50%; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6366F1,#F97316); padding:3px; box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(99,102,241,0.3); }
      .avatar-inner { width:100%; height:100%; border-radius:50%; background:#EEF2FF; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; overflow:hidden; }
      .avatar-inner i { font-size:4rem; color:#6366F1; opacity:0.5; }
      /* STATS */
      .stats-row { display:flex; gap:1rem; margin-top:3rem; flex-wrap:wrap; }
      .stat-box { background:#fff; border:1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius:14px; padding:1.2rem 1.6rem; flex:1; min-width:130px; transition:all 0.3s; }
      .stat-box:hover { border-color:#6366F1; box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(99,102,241,0.12); transform:translateY(-3px); }
      .stat-num { font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-size:1.8rem; font-weight:800; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6366F1,#F97316); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; display:block; }
      .stat-lbl { font-size:0.78rem; color:#64748B; font-weight:500; margin-top:0.1rem; }
      /* BLOG SECTION */
      .sec-wrap { max-width:900px; margin:0 auto; padding:3rem 2rem; }
      .sec-top { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-end; margin-bottom:1.8rem; }
      .sec-top h2 { font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-size:1.6rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.02em; }
      .see-all { font-size:0.85rem; color:#6366F1; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.3rem; transition:gap 0.2s; }
      .see-all:hover { gap:0.6rem; }
      .blog-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:1.2rem; }
      .bcard { background:#fff; border:1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius:16px; overflow:hidden; transition:all 0.3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); cursor:pointer; }
      .bcard:hover { border-color:#6366F1; box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(99,102,241,0.15); transform:translateY(-5px); }
      .bcard-thumb { height:110px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:2rem; }
      .bcard-body { padding:1.1rem; }
      .bcard-body h3 { font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-size:0.92rem; font-weight:700; margin:0.5rem 0 0.4rem; line-height:1.35; }
      .bcard-body h3 a { text-decoration:none; color:#0D1117; }
      .bcard-body h3 a:hover { color:#6366F1; }
      .bcard-body p { font-size:0.82rem; color:#64748B; line-height:1.6; }
      /* PUB SECTION */
      .pub-highlight { background:#fff; border:1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius:20px; padding:1.8rem 2rem; display:flex; gap:2rem; align-items:center; transition:all 0.3s; }
      .pub-highlight:hover { border-color:#6366F1; box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(99,102,241,0.12); }
      .pub-icon-wrap { width:70px; height:90px; border-radius:12px; background:linear-gradient(160deg,#6366F1,#818CF8); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-shrink:0; box-shadow:4px 6px 16px rgba(99,102,241,0.3); }
      .pub-icon-wrap i { font-size:2rem; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.8); }
      .pub-content h3 { font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:0.5rem; }
      .pub-content p { font-size:0.88rem; color:#64748B; line-height:1.65; margin-bottom:1rem; }
      /* BG DECORATION */
      .hero-bg { position:relative; overflow:hidden; }
      .hero-bg::before { content:''; position:absolute; top:-100px; right:-100px; width:500px; height:500px; border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(99,102,241,0.08),transparent 70%); pointer-events:none; }
      .hero-bg::after { content:''; position:absolute; bottom:-80px; left:-80px; width:350px; height:350px; border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(249,115,22,0.07),transparent 70%); pointer-events:none; }
      @media(max-width:640px){.hero-cols{flex-direction:column-reverse;gap:2rem;}.hero-text h1{font-size:2.2rem;}.blog-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}.pub-highlight{flex-direction:column;}.stats-row{gap:0.7rem;}}
    </style>
---
